Durchlauchtigſter Fürſt
Gnädigster Fürst und Herr!
Ewr Hochfürstliche Durchlaucht übermache ich angebogen daß Exposée
was ich dem Herrn Weigel gegeben habe, er lebt und webt in
dieser Sache, und erklärt, daß er die Knobelsdorffsche Güter
meinet. Ich werde nun noch mit Hainen das weitere einleiten da¬
mit auch der gestimmt, sein fiat zu allen giebt - ich glaube
indes daß Weigel diesmal ohne diesen Handeln wird, inzwischen ist
es gut wann jeder Stein des Anstoßes aus dem Wege geräumt
ist. Mein bemühen geht jezt dahin nur 500 Rthl zusammen zu treiben,
um den 11ten dieses nach Zagorowo abzugehen und alles dorten so zu
ordenen um dH. v Knobelse ortt die Sache offen und
untadelhaft vor mitem zu können.
Wegen Schweinern ſtehe ich mit dem Kaufmann Wiener ſo wie
auch mit dem Kaufmann Schiller in Unterhandlung - Tismar schreibt
aus Berlin ſehr Miſtisch – Er sagt man würde gewis zufrieden
sein - im Grunde ist das nichts als ein Schall-
Gebe nur Gott Seegen und Gedeihen zu meine Pläne, den können
Ewr Durchlaucht mit mir alle die Narren verlachen.
Meine tiefſte Verehrung Ihren Kindern. Ewig aber
Ewr Hochfürstliche Durchlaucht
Schweinern den 2ten August.
1810
treu unterthänigster Diener
v Triebenfeld

Wie mir H. p Eberhardt versichert so ist auch an den Züdisch gepriesenen
Güter Lauſch mit Strachnitz auch nicht ein wahres Wörtchen. Strachard
weis auch nicht eine Sylbe davon.
Seit einiger Zeit hat mir Fischbach beigehende Taxen vom Güter
gegeben die einem gewißen v Knobelsdorff gehören
der will gegen Pohl Güter tauschen¬
Die dicken Faxen scheinen ſelbſt gemacht die Kleinen aber von Fischbach
aus der Landschatz Taxe extrahiert zu sein.
Fischbach sagt Knobelsdorff läßt die Güter für 70000 Rthl
Schulden stehen darauf 255000 Rthl Pfandbriefen 135000 Rthl
Privat Schulden dies beträgt.
390000 Rthl
bleibt zu Gute.
310000 Rthl
Die Zagorower Güter sollen tragen circa 27000 Rthl wäre am
Werth von

darauf stehen Schulden

50000.

8000.

24000.

bleib an Werth gut    293000 Rthl
Es wurden also die Knobelsdorffschen Güter einen höheren Wertschoben von 17000 Rthl
Fischbach erbietet sich diesen Güter Tausch, wenn er Ewer Durchlaucht
Intresse zuträglich ist, zu stande zu bringen. Für seine Mühe
verlangt er 1 1/2 pr Ct. Gewesen Ewr Durchlaucht durch dieſen
Expreffen die Befehle zu ertheilen, ob Fischbach mit Knobels
dorffen nach Schlawenschitz kommen soll.
v Triebenfeld
Noch bemerke ich umstehen

die 17000 Rthl welche die Knobelsdorffschen Güter mehr werth ſind werden,
durch die ausstehenden Reste, so wie auch die etwärmigen Ausfälle
bey den 27000 Rthl Revenuen, die bey den schlechten Zeiten eintreten dürfen
gedeckt
Vieleicht nimt dann noch Knobelsdorff die Trąbczyner Güter mit dem
darauf stehenden, als auch noch sonstigen Schulden, und führt selber
dem Prozeß vollends aus
Geruhen Ewr Durchlaucht aber ja gründlich Ihre Meinung über alles
zu ſagen, damit ich die Leute rüh beſcheiden, und nach Schlawen
Schul Einweisen kan - Ich konte sonsten wieder von dem höch Ver¬
trauten mit neue ehem Titulo belegt werden.

translation.en:
Most Serene Prince

Most gracious Prince and Lord!

To Your Most Serene Highness I transmit herewith the exposé which I have given to Mr. Weigel; he lives and breathes in this affair, and declares that he means the Knobelsdorff estates. I shall now set the further steps in motion with Hainen as well, so that he too may be brought round to give his fiat to everything — I believe, however, that Weigel will this time act without him; in the meanwhile it is well if every stone of offence is cleared out of the way. My endeavour is now directed only to scraping together 500 Rthl, in order to set out on the 11th of this month for Zagorowo and there to arrange everything so that the affair may be laid open and blameless before [uncertain: mitem] at Mr. von Knobelse's place.

Concerning Schweinern I am in negotiation with the merchant Wiener as also with the merchant Schiller — Tismar writes very mystically from Berlin – He says one would certainly be satisfied — at bottom this is nothing but empty noise. May God only grant blessing and prosperity to my plans, and then Your Serene Highness may laugh at all the fools along with me. My deepest reverence to your children. Ever, however, Your Most Serene Highness's

Schweinern, the 2nd of August.

1810

faithful most humble and obedient servant

v. Triebenfeld

As Mr. von Eberhardt assures me, there is likewise not one true little word in the Jewishly praised estates Lausch with Strachnitz. Strachard too does not know a syllable of it. Some time ago Fischbach gave me the enclosed valuations of estates belonging to a certain von Knobelsdorff, who wishes to exchange them against Polish estates. The large figures appear to have been made up by himself, the small ones however to have been extracted by Fischbach from the Landschaft valuation. Fischbach says Knobelsdorff is leaving the estates standing with 70000 Rthl of debts, upon them 255000 Rthl in mortgage bonds, 135000 Rthl in private debts; this amounts to 390000 Rthl

there remains to the good.

310000 Rthl The Zagorowo estates are said to yield about 27000 Rthl, which would be at a value of

540000 f.

upon them stand debts

1 the Invalids' Fund

50000 Rthl

2. the Oppenheimer debt together with arrears of interest 115000.

3. Weigel 50000.

4. Seher Thos 8000.

5. Onera perpetua about 1200 Rthl, capitalised — 24000.

makes in capital 247000 Rthl, there remains good in value 293000 Rthl. The Knobelsdorff estates would thus show a higher value of 17000 Rthl. Fischbach offers to bring about this exchange of estates, if it is conducive to Your Serene Highness's interest. For his trouble he asks 1 1/2 per cent. May it please Your Serene Highness to issue by this express the commands whether Fischbach should come with Knobelsdorff to Schlawenschitz. v. Triebenfeld I further note overleaf

the 17000 Rthl by which the Knobelsdorff estates are worth more will be covered by the outstanding arrears, as also by the [uncertain: seasonal] shortfalls in the 27000 Rthl of revenues which in these bad times may be expected. Perhaps Knobelsdorff will then also take the Trąbczyn estates with the debts standing upon them, as also such others as there are, and carry the lawsuit through to its end himself. But may it please Your Serene Highness to state your opinion on everything thoroughly, so that I may [uncertain: calmly] instruct the people and direct them to Schlawenschitz — otherwise I might again be saddled by the most highly trusted with some new honorary title.

Most Serene Prince

Most gracious Prince and Lord!

To Your Most Serene Highness I transmit herewith the exposé which I have given to Mr. Weigel; he lives and breathes in this affair, and declares that he means the Knobelsdorff estates. I shall now set the further steps in motion with Hainen as well, so that he too may be brought round to give his fiat to everything — I believe, however, that Weigel will this time act without him; in the meanwhile it is well if every stone of offence is cleared out of the way. My endeavour is now directed only to scraping together 500 Rthl, in order to set out on the 11th of this month for Zagorowo and there to arrange everything so that the affair may be laid open and blameless before [uncertain: mitem] at Mr. von Knobelse's place.

Concerning Schweinern I am in negotiation with the merchant Wiener as also with the merchant Schiller — Tismar writes very mystically from Berlin – He says one would certainly be satisfied — at bottom this is nothing but empty noise. May God only grant blessing and prosperity to my plans, and then Your Serene Highness may laugh at all the fools along with me. My deepest reverence to your children. Ever, however, Your Most Serene Highness's

Schweinern, the 2nd of August.

1810

faithful most humble and obedient servant

v. Triebenfeld

As Mr. von Eberhardt assures me, there is likewise not one true little word in the Jewishly praised estates Lausch with Strachnitz. Strachard too does not know a syllable of it. Some time ago Fischbach gave me the enclosed valuations of estates belonging to a certain von Knobelsdorff, who wishes to exchange them against Polish estates. The large figures appear to have been made up by himself, the small ones however to have been extracted by Fischbach from the Landschaft valuation. Fischbach says Knobelsdorff is leaving the estates standing with 70000 Rthl of debts, upon them 255000 Rthl in mortgage bonds, 135000 Rthl in private debts; this amounts to 390000 Rthl

there remains to the good.

310000 Rthl The Zagorowo estates are said to yield about 27000 Rthl, which would be at a value of

540000 f.

upon them stand debts

1 the Invalids' Fund

50000 Rthl

2. the Oppenheimer debt together with arrears of interest 115000.

3. Weigel 50000.

4. Seher Thos 8000.

5. Onera perpetua about 1200 Rthl, capitalised — 24000.

makes in capital 247000 Rthl, there remains good in value 293000 Rthl. The Knobelsdorff estates would thus show a higher value of 17000 Rthl. Fischbach offers to bring about this exchange of estates, if it is conducive to Your Serene Highness's interest. For his trouble he asks 1 1/2 per cent. May it please Your Serene Highness to issue by this express the commands whether Fischbach should come with Knobelsdorff to Schlawenschitz. v. Triebenfeld I further note overleaf

the 17000 Rthl by which the Knobelsdorff estates are worth more will be covered by the outstanding arrears, as also by the [uncertain: seasonal] shortfalls in the 27000 Rthl of revenues which in these bad times may be expected. Perhaps Knobelsdorff will then also take the Trąbczyn estates with the debts standing upon them, as also such others as there are, and carry the lawsuit through to its end himself. But may it please Your Serene Highness to state your opinion on everything thoroughly, so that I may [uncertain: calmly] instruct the people and direct them to Schlawenschitz — otherwise I might again be saddled by the most highly trusted with some new honorary title.
summary_en: Encloses the Exposée given to Weigel, who is engrossed in the affair and means the Knobelsdorff estates; Hainen is to be brought round, though Weigel may act without him. Triebenfeld is scraping together 500 Rthl to leave on the 11th for Zagorowo, and negotiates over Schweinern with the merchants Wiener and Schiller; Tismar writes mystically from Berlin. Fischbach's figures compare Knobelsdorff's estates (390,000 Rthl debts, 310,000 clear) with Zagorowo (247,000 debts, 293,000 clear), proposing an exchange for 1½ per cent; asks whether Fischbach and Knobelsdorff should come to Schlawenschitz, Trąbczyn possibly included.
summary_de: Übersendung des Weigel überreichten Exposée; Weigel meine die Knobelsdorffschen Güter und werde diesmal wohl ohne Hainen handeln. Triebenfeld sucht 500 Rthl zusammenzubringen, um am 11. nach Zagorowo zu reisen; wegen Schweinern verhandelt er mit den Kaufleuten Wiener und Schiller, Tismar schreibe aus Berlin nur mystisch. Nach Eberhardt und Strachard sei an den Gütern Lausch mit Strachnitz nichts. Fischbach bietet gegen 1 1/2 Prozent einen Gütertausch: Knobelsdorffs Güter (390000 Rthl Schulden, 310000 Rthl Rest) gegen Zagorowo (247000 Rthl Schulden, 293000 Rthl Rest), eventuell samt Trąbczyn; Anfrage, ob Fischbach und Knobelsdorff nach Schlawenschitz kommen sollen.
